text:
sara: FYI merged cust-quill LoRA into staging, ran int4 smoke. Seeing consistent upward bias on currency extraction (amounts rounded +1 to +3 cents) on invoice samples. quick eval attached.

ev an: oof, can you paste a minimal repro? sample input/output?

sara: pasted a tiny diff repro from the smokepack:

```
cmd: python eval_pack/run_smoke.py --model quill-lora-int4 --dataset samples/invoices/seed-12.jsonl --metrics amount_exact_match
output snippet:
{"id":"inv-001","pred_amount":"$102.03","gold":"$102.00"}
{"id":"inv-002","pred_amount":"$47.99","gold":"$47.95"}
{"id":"inv-003","pred_amount":"$0.00","gold":"$0.00"}
```

ciara: interesting that zeros are fine. seems like small positive bias only. did you re-run on fp16 baseline?

sara: yes — fp16 baseline gives exact matches for same samples. int4 only shows +0.03 / +0.04 diffs mostly.

ev an: could be tokenizer rounding on decimal separators or quantized logits shifting numeral tokens. any change in tokenizer mapping after merge?

mike: checked the adapter merge diff — no tokenizer changes. LoRA weights only. but we did enable per-channel quantization fallback for a few layers in the runtime, maybe interactions there.

ciara: can you run a quick controlled ablation: int4 with KV-cache disabled, and int4 with 8-bit attention kernel?

bench-bot: scheduled job qb-3587654321-ablation started: tags [cust-quill,int4-bias,invoice-samples], ETA ~8m

sara: results coming in. first pass: int4 + kv-cache off -> bias reduced but still present (~+0.01-+0.02). int4 with 8-bit attention kernel -> bias gone on sample set.

mike: that points at attention kernel quantization interacting with LoRA deltas. maybe certain softmax scaling underflows and pushes numeric tokens up.

evan: good signal. propose short path: 1) pin customer to int8-attention kernel on Dedicated for rollout, 2) open issue to investigate kernel quantization scaling, 3) add a quick eval to the rollback checklist to detect numeric bias.

ciara: +1. also add a small unit test in the eval pack that checks invoice rounding within +/- $0.01 across merges.

deploy-bot: canary deploy blocked: policy triggered by "quantization-regression" check in repo redwood/cust-quill -> requires manual approval.

sara: I'll update the quick-eval pack and a short note in the customer onboarding sheet. assigning to @mike for kernel triage.

mike: ack. I'll reproduce locally with nvprof and dump attention logits for the failing tokens. will post logs here.

bench-bot: job qb-3587654321-ablation finished: summary attached to /artifacts/qb-3587654321 (int4->8bit-kernel delta: numeric bias eliminated; kv-cache change: partial improvement).

evan: thanks. one more ask — can we run a small benchmark comparing token-level entropy for numeric tokens between fp16/int4-int8-kernel? might help isolate softmax instability.

mike: on it. expected results ~30m.

ciara: nice catch, sara. also add note to the rollout playbook so next LAUNCH for cust-quill uses int8-attention by default until kernel fix is in. :memo:

sara: done, PR opened w/ updated eval pack and playbook note: https://git.internal/redwood/cust-quill/merge-requests/42 :thumbsup:
